title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.add_one_lt_of_even
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.add_one_lt_of_even` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, Even n → Even m → n < m → n + 1 < m
formal.kernel_statement: ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat.Even x0) -> ((x3 : AxNat.Even x1) -> ((x4 : AxNat.lt x0 x1) -> AxNat.lt (AxNat.add x0 (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) x1)))))
